design.title: DevDay Night Run
design.intro: Deliver the early DevDay ticket before sunrise. Collect all three signals.
design.background_prompt: Compact pixel-art night scene for a side-scrolling browser game set in San Francisco: steep streets, cable-car tracks, bay mist, distant bridge silhouettes, warm apartment windows, moonlit clouds, subtle neon reflections, dark blue palette with teal signal glow and amber highlights. No logos, no copyrighted characters, no real event branding.
design.atlas_prompt: Pixel-art sprite atlas for a compact browser runner game: small courier runner with a glowing ticket, three collectible signal shards labeled only in UI as GPT, Image, Ship, traffic cones, fog puffs, streetlights, crosswalk stripes, cable-car rail obstacles, finish mailbox, sparkle effects. Transparent background, cohesive night palette, no logos, no copyrighted characters, no real event branding.
